;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 North Maluku earthquake]]
**A 7.2 magnitude earthquake rocked North Maluku, causing damages to thousands of structures across the province. At least 14 people were killed in the quake. [https://web.archive.org/web/20190718005043/http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-07/17/c_138234618.htm (Xinhua)]
*A [[GippsAero GA8 Airvan]] [[sky diving]] operation plane crashes on an island outside [[Umeå]], [[Sweden]], killing all nine people onboard. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/15/skydiving-plane-crash-kills-all-nine-on-board (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[Argentina–Brazil relations]]
**[[President of Brazil|Brazilian President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] renews his support for the [[2019 Argentine general election|re-election]] of [[President of Argentina|Argentine President]] [[Mauricio Macri]]. "We're brothers, and I want prosperity for our nations," he concludes in an interview. [https://www.clarin.com/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-presidente-brasil-quiero-argentina-siga-linea-venezuela-apoyo-reeleccion-macri_0_r0JjNpoAE.html (''Clarín'')]

;Science and technology
*The [[European Union]]'s [[Galileo (satellite navigation)|Galileo]] [[satellite navigation]] system suffers a major outage due to a "technical incident related to its ground infrastructure," taking all active Galileo satellites offline. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-48985399 (BBC News)]

;Sports
*[[2019 Wimbledon Championships]]
**In the [[2019 Wimbledon Championships – Men's Singles|men's singles]] [[2019 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles final|final match]], Serbian [[Novak Djokovic]] beats Swiss [[Roger Federer]] in five sets for his 16th [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] [[List of Grand Slam related tennis records|title win]] in a match that lasted four hours and 56 minutes. It was the [[All-time tennis records – men's singles|longest Wimbledon final of all time]], and also the first men's singles final in any of the four Grand Slam events that went to a fifth-set tiebreaker. [https://www.wimbledon.com/en_GB/news/articles/2019-07-14/djokovic_completes_hattrick_of_final_wins_against_federer.html (Wimbledon)] [https://www.espn.com/tennis/story/_/id/27189215/djokovic-tops-federer-epic-wimbledon-final (ESPN)]
*[[2019 Cricket World Cup]]
**[[England cricket team|England]] beats [[New Zealand national cricket team|New Zealand]] in the [[2019 Cricket World Cup Final]] on total [[Boundary (cricket)#Scoring runs|boundaries]] after both regulation play and a [[super over]] end in a tie. [https://www.espn.com/cricket/series/8039/game/1144530/england-vs-new-zealand-final-icc-cricket-world-cup-2019.html (ESPN)]
